in_marathi.name: Kishu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kishu is derived from Sanskrit and means 'God's Grace'. In Hindu mythology, the deity Kishore, a form of Lord Krishna, is believed to bestow his blessings upon those named after him.
